nainfini.frames.assault.Name: Sirius
nainfini.frames.assault.Description: Balanced powered armor. Its twin machine gun takes your secondary slot while you wear it (limited ammo, no refills). Special: a short charge that breaks weak doors and shoves enemies aside.
nainfini.frames.tank.Name: Taishan
nainfini.frames.tank.Description: The heaviest armor, with a heavy machine gun in your secondary slot. Special: an energy barrier around the suit stops enemy attacks on everyone inside; it breaks when emptied and comes back after a pause. Carries heavy objects at full speed.
nainfini.frames.firepower.Name: Thunderbird
nainfini.frames.firepower.Description: Gun platform with the hardest-hitting heavy machine gun. Special: siege mode plants the suit; it cannot walk, but fires faster and takes less damage. The rocket key launches four shoulder rockets at the point you look at.
nainfini.frames.scout.Name: Nightowl
nainfini.frames.scout.Description: Light, fast armor with an anti-materiel rifle in your secondary slot. Special: every 5 seconds it marks every enemy within 30 m, the way the bio tracker does.
